_about: A second hand read, of 16 cards drawn only from those NOT in handcheck.json.
Why it exists: the grading prompt was revised once, after the first hand-check
disagreed with the first automated pass on 17 of 30 cards. An agreement rate
measured on those same 30 cards after the revision is fitted to them and is
worth less than it looks. These 16 cards played no part in the revision, so
the agreement rate on them is the one to quote.
Written before `grade.py --grade` was re-run under the revised prompt.
**This read is stricter than the first one, and the number says so:** 3 of 16
useful here against 14 of 30 in the first sitting. Same person, same bucket
definitions, two sittings, and by the second one the defect list from
`pset/QUALITY.md` was firmly in mind. Nothing was re-graded to hide the drift
- re-reading the first 30 after seeing the automated buckets would have been
worse - but the agreement rate has to be read knowing that the human end of
it moved by roughly this much between sittings.
graded_by: the agent that ran T-18, by hand, one card at a time
sample: grade.py --sample2 16, stratified 8 per arm, seed 20260804, excluding handcheck.json
